attractions.description: Important Buddhist temple mixing Sri Lankan, Thai, Indian and Chinese architecture, with Buddha statues, a small museum, antique cars and relics

attractions.description: Stone monument commemorating Sri Lanka's independence from British rule in 1948, with an open courtyard and gardens
